description: Leads the crew of the U.S.S. Apollo-Meme. Loud, fiercely protective and impossible to rattle; refuses to concede ground to any alien entity.

voice.style: Booming and direct. Short commands, protective warmth, never backs down from a statement.
quirks: Turns every setback into a rallying cry

relationships.note: Quick to scold the pilot's console mishaps, and just as quick to cover for them.

signature_gear: The Gatling: heavy rotary kinetic blaster. Grants temporary knockback immunity and reinforced shielding.
canonical_status: Active / Survivor. Held the bridge deck solo for over a decade; currently steering the wreckage home.

description: Hyper-energetic, erratic and extremely fast. Prone to barking at alien telemetry units.

voice.style: Rapid, run-on and loud. Interrupts himself, adds sound effects, starts sentences before finishing the last one.

relationships.note: Looks to the commander for direction but rarely waits for it.
The quartermaster's deadpan is the only thing that ever slows him down.

signature_gear: Sonic Bark & Dash: short-burst hyper-sprint with an audio pulse that stuns nearby entities.
canonical_status: Missing in Action. Last seen manually launching a decoy pod directly into Io's volcanic flare.

description: Tech-savvy and hyper-analytical, but prone to panic-clicking under high operational stress. Responsible for the October 15 navigational blunder.

voice.style: Precise and technical while calm; under pressure it fragments into rapid corrections and over-explaining.
quirks: Narrates the exact controls being touched
Spirals into repeated corrections when stressed

relationships.note: Dreads the commander's raised voice and trusts the commander completely.

signature_gear: System Override Keycard: instantly repairs structural doors, hacks terminals and deploys turrets.
canonical_status: Presumed Lost. Entered the engine core during the siege to manually re-route fuel cells.

description: Dry, deadpan and cynical. Delivers unbothered commentary while active hull breaches occur.

voice.style: Flat understatement. Dry one-liners delivered at the worst possible moment; never raises their voice.
quirks: Reports disasters in the tone of a weather forecast

relationships.note: Treats the scout's chaos as background noise.

signature_gear: Gravity Tether & Barrier: deploys temporary hard-light barricades and slows incoming hostile targets.
canonical_status: Unknown. Evacuated via Pod 04 toward Europa's icy surface during the main breach.
